title: A site published by SQL or a seed script gets its free subdomain attached
detail: Found 2026-10-27 when alli-rae.frequencylocal.com closed the connection. The free <slug>.frequencylocal.com address is attached to the Vercel project only when Publish is pressed in the Space panel (setWebsitePublished calls addSiteSubdomain). A seed or SQL that sets the published flag directly never attaches it, so the address has no certificate. Needed: a small script (using lib/sites/vercel-domains.ts addSiteSubdomain) that the seed docs name as the last step, so a seeded site is reachable. Re-test the premise before working it: confirm Publish still attaches and wildcard is still not configured.
